answer: Every newcomer must survey one mountain pass before joining. A licensed surveyor climbs with a theodolite and files the bearing of an onyx marker stone at the summit; two others re-measure it within seven days, and a mismatch over half a degree voids the claim and burns a 500 POA bond. The zephyr on the ridge makes one survey cost $340, so 100 fakes need 100 surveys, $34,000 in fees and 50,000 POA in bonds; the pass keeps a fable climbers know.
